    Description

    A Date class that represents a calendar date in mm/dd/yyyy format.

    This enum class represents the different departments that employees can belong to.

    This enum class represents employees by their last names.

    Make
    An enum class that enumerates through different vehicle makes.

    This class creates an array of bookings, where if the array is full adds 4 more spaces to the array Then, additional lines of description are added to elaborate on the details if necessary.

    This class implements a specific type of vehicle (Sedan) to calculate the charge and surcharge.
    Sort
    This class creates a circularly linked list of trips.

    This class represents a trip with a booking, beginning mileage, and ending mileage, Also has methods for equality checks and string representation.
    TripList
    This class creates a circularly linked list of trips.

    This class implements a specific type of vehicle (Truck) to calculate the charge and surcharge.
